Game Overview

Playometro Remake is a platformer title where embark on a cosmic adventure as a red alien exploring diverse landscapes. Reclaim lost coins scattered across forests, deserts, snowfields, swamps, and volcanoes. Destroy enemies for extra rewards and compete globally to become the ultimate coin collector. Rediscover the thrill of exploring and outscoring everyone!
